PublicProject.title: PublicProject
PublicProject.description: Publicly publishable portfolio project metadata matching the external portfolio schema, served by GET /api/portfolio/projects when published is true.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who created this project.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier for portfolio API lookup.

description.description: Project description displayed on portfolio cards and detail views.

image.description: Optional HTTPS cover image URL for the project.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 12 technology or topic tags.

type.description: Project platform type (Website or Mobile App).

published.description: Whether this project is published to the public Portfolio JSON API.

featured.description: Whether this project is highlighted on the portfolio.

displayOrder.description: Sort order index for portfolio rendering.

AdminProjectMeta.title: AdminProjectMeta
AdminProjectMeta.description: Private owner-only operational links (Auth, DB, Hosting, Monitoring dashboards) and internal notes, isolated from public portfolio reads.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

authDashboardUrl.description: Direct link to the project's Authentication console.

dbDashboardUrl.description: Direct link to the project's Database console.

hostingDashboardUrl.description: Direct link to the project's Hosting / Deployment dashboard.

monitoringUrl.description: Direct link to logs, analytics, or monitoring console.

environmentNotes.description: Private operational notes for the owner.

providerTags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 infrastructure provider tags.

PublicGalleryPhoto.title: PublicGalleryPhoto
PublicGalleryPhoto.description: Portfolio photography item belonging either to Section A (5-slot featured grid) or Section B (unlimited gallery images), served by GET /api/portfolio/gallery when published is true.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

section.description: Target portfolio section: grid (5 fixed slots) or gallery (unlimited images).

slot.description: Fixed slot number 1..5 for grid section, or 0 for gallery section.

title.description: Optional title or short caption for the photograph.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the hosted photograph.

category.description: Optional photography category or collection label.

displayOrder.description: Sort order index for gallery rendering.

published.description: Whether this photo is returned by the public Portfolio Gallery JSON API.

PublicBlog.title: PublicBlog
PublicBlog.description: Portfolio blog article managed in Aurora Command Hub and served publicly by GET /api/portfolio/blogs when published is true.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who authored this blog post.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier for portfolio blog routing and API lookup.

excerpt.description: Short summary shown on portfolio blog cards and previews.

content.description: Full Markdown body content of the blog post.

category.description: Optional blog category such as Engineering, Design, or Notes.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 12 topic tags.

publishedDate.description: Display publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

readTime.description: Estimated reading time label (e.g., 4 min read).

published.description: Whether this blog post is returned by the public Portfolio Blogs API.

featured.description: Whether this blog post is pinned or featured on the portfolio.

displayOrder.description: Sort order index for blog listing.

/public_projects/{projectId}.description: Publicly readable portfolio projects when published == true (or legacy status == 'published'); owner-only writes and full visibility for unpublished drafts.

/admin_projects/{projectId}.description: Strictly owner-only operational console URLs and internal notes split from public_projects to prevent metadata leaks.

/public_gallery/{photoId}.description: Portfolio gallery photos split into 5 fixed Grid slots (section == 'grid', slot 1..5) and unlimited Gallery images (section == 'gallery', slot == 0).

/public_blogs/{blogId}.description: Publicly readable portfolio blog articles when published == true; owner-only writes and full visibility for unpublished drafts.
